snippet.title: KLETKA OFFICIAL LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
⚠️ *KLETKA is out from Early Access on PC and consoles (PS4, PS5 and Xbox)!* ⚠️

PLAY NOW: https://s.team/a/1699480

KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

Composed by Eskimo:
dm (tg) - https://t.me/matthewl22

Console Porting by Sobaka Studio:
https://www.youtube.com/@UC_Qef_kOMwJIEeocZgHXP2w 

#KLETKA #Gaming #Trailer #ln404
